ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ صَاحِبِ الرِّسَالَةِ وَالْبَلَاغِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ṣāhibi ‘r-Risālati wa ‘l-Balāgh.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family trustee of the message and conveyance!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ صَلَاةً تَمْلَأُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْفَرَاغَ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ṣalātan tamla’u ‘s-Samāwāti wa ‘l-farāgh.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family a prayer filling the heavens and voids!

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الْآمِرِ بِالْعَدْلِ وَ الْإِنْصَافِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī,  Al-Āmiri bi ‘l-`adli wa ‘l-inṣāf.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the instructor of justice and equity!
